description:
Get pinned messages in a channel. In a guild channel the bot needs VIEW_CHANNEL and READ_MESSAGE_HISTORY to see pins.

Args:
  - channel_id (string): Discord channel ID
  - limit (number, optional): Maximum pins per page (1-50, default: 50). Supply this to receive pagination metadata.
  - before (string, optional): Get messages pinned before this ISO 8601 timestamp. Use next_before from the previous page.
  - response_format ('markdown' | 'json'): Output format (default: 'json')

Returns:
  A list of pinned messages by default. Supplying limit or before adds pin timestamps and pagination metadata.

before.description: ISO 8601 pin timestamp. Use next_before from the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of pins in a page. Supply a limit to receive pagination metadata.

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data

name: discord_get_pinned_messages
title: Get Pinned Messages
